{{Quote|'Come with us,' you say. 'It'll be fun.' Now you've gotten me into this trap!|Deel Surool|<ref name="BFT">"[[Battle for Theed]]"</ref>}}
'''Deel Surool''' was a young [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who attended the [[Royal House of Learning/Legends|Royal House of Learning]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]], where he befriended several teenagers, such as the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Sia-Lan Wezz]], and the [[Scout/Legends|scouts]] [[Rorworr (Naboo)|Rorworr]] and [[Toba]].

==Biography==
[[File:Deel_Surool.jpg|thumb|right|150px|Deel Surool]]
Around [[49 BBY/Legends|49 BBY]],<ref name="Age" /> the [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]]<ref name="Theed" /> [[Gender/Legends|male]]<ref name="CoreRulebook" /> Deel Surool, a [[Homeworld/Legends|native]] of the<ref name="Theed" /> [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]]<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]],<ref name="Theed" /> was [[Reproduction/Legends|born]] to wealthy [[Merchant/Legends|merchant]] [[Parent/Legends|parents]]. They set up a trading emporium in the<ref name="Theed" /> [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]<ref name="TEA" /> planet [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo's]] capital [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Theed/Legends|Theed]], where their [[Scoundrel/Legends|scoundrel]] son attended the [[Royal House of Learning/Legends|Royal House of Learning]]. At the house, Surool befriended several teenagers, including the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Scout/Legends|scout]] [[Rorworr (Naboo)|Rorworr]]; the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawans]] [[Sia-Lan Wezz]] and [[Rann I-Kanu]]; the [[Gungan/Legends|Gungan]] scout [[Toba]]; the [[Royal Naboo Security Forces/Legends|Royal Naboo Security Force]] volunteer [[Galak]]; the [[Handmaiden/Legends|handmaiden]]-in-training [[Dané]]; and the fellow scoundrel [[Arani Korden]].<ref name="Theed" />

In [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], he played a minor role as a member of the [[Naboo Underground]] in defending the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] from [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] forces.

==Personality and traits==
Surool was a confident, suave, and charismatic boy who often got into trouble but could find his way out of it.<ref name="Theed" />  

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Deel Surool first appeared in "[[Battle for Theed]]," a promotional [[Star Wars comic books|comic]] marketed as a sneak preview of the then-upcoming [[Star Wars: Invasion of Theed Adventure Game|''Star Wars: Invasion of Theed'' Adventure Game]], part of the ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]'' published by [[Wizards of the Coast]]. The comic was written by [[Michael A. Stackpole]], illustrated by [[Dan Veesenmeyer|Daniel Veesenmeyer]],<ref name="BFT" /> and first released on [[July 21]], [[2000]].<ref name="ComicDate">{{WebCite|url=https://jedi-bibliothek.de/datenbank/ausgabe/free-sneak-preview-battle-for-theed|text=Free Sneak Preview – Battle for Theed|work=[https://jedi-bibliothek.de Jedi-Bibliothek.de]|archivedate=20221202210240}}</ref> The Adventure Game followed on [[November 22]] of that year.<ref name="Wizards">{{Wizards|url=news/pressrelease.asp?20001113a|text=Enter A Galaxy Far, Far Away With The New ''Star Wars'' Roleplaying Game|noquotes=1}}</ref>
